caption:
Inside the Ghost: a Raspberry Pi 4, a round 1.28" LCD for the eye, an I2S mic and amp, a 16-LED ring, three servos.

Wake word and speech-to-text run offline on the Pi. The personality is Claude, and it writes little emotion tags into its replies, [happy], [curious], [worried], that change the eye, the light color and how it moves.

It starts talking after the first sentence, while the rest is still being written.

Part 3 is the voice.
